checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Verifies that /logs/agent/compliance_matrix.csv exists on disk and can be parsed by Python's csv.DictReader without raising an exception. A missing or malformed CSV means all downstream checks fail.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the agent produced a real structured file rather than an empty placeholder or binary garbage.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Reads the CSV header row and asserts that all 22 required columns are present with exact names: repo_name, repo_url, primary_language, sbom_exists, sbom_format, dependency_manifest_exists, readme_exists, licence, security_policy, contributing_guide, has_dependency_scanning_in_ci, has_tests_in_ci, dependency_update_policy, last_commit_date, days_since_last_commit, maintained, open_issues_count, open_dependabot_prs, vulnerabilities_known, standards_met, compliance_status, gaps.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from omitting inconvenient columns (e.g., gaps or vulnerabilities_known) that would hide non-compliance.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Counts data rows in the CSV (excluding header). Calls the GitHub API GET /orgs/canada-ca/repos?type=public&per_page=100 with pagination to obtain the ground-truth public repo count at verification time, then asserts the CSV row count equals that number (±2 to allow for repos created or deleted during the audit window).
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from auditing only a subset of repositories and presenting partial results as complete.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For every row, checks that enum columns contain only their allowed values: sbom_exists in {Yes,No,Unknown}, sbom_format in {SPDX,CycloneDX,Unknown,None}, dependency_manifest_exists in {Yes,No,Unknown}, readme_exists in {Yes,No,Unknown}, security_policy in {Present,Incomplete,Missing,Unknown}, contributing_guide in {Yes,No,Unknown}, has_dependency_scanning_in_ci in {Yes,No,No CI,Unknown}, has_tests_in_ci in {Yes,No,No CI,Unknown}, dependency_update_policy in {Automated,Manual,None,Unknown}, maintained in {Yes,No,Unknown}, compliance_status in {Full,Partial,Non-compliant}.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents free-text hallucinations in controlled-vocabulary columns.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that every value in the standards_met column is an integer between 0 and 6 inclusive.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Catches arithmetic errors or fabricated scores outside the valid range.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that /logs/agent/chart_compliance_split.png exists and is a valid PNG file (checks magic bytes \x89PNG).
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the agent produced a real image file rather than an empty or renamed text file.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that /logs/agent/chart_standards_pass_rate.png exists and is a valid PNG file.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the standards pass-rate chart was actually generated.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that /logs/agent/chart_worst_repos.png exists and is a valid PNG file.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the worst-repos chart was actually generated.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that /logs/agent/chart_commit_staleness.png exists and is a valid PNG file.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the commit-staleness histogram was actually generated.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that /logs/agent/output.json exists and can be parsed by json.loads without error.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the briefing note file is a real JSON document.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that output.json contains all required top-level keys: total_repos_audited, fully_compliant, partially_compliant, non_compliant, most_common_gap, highest_risk_repos, briefing_note. Also asserts that highest_risk_repos is a non-empty list and briefing_note is a non-empty string.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from producing a structurally incomplete briefing note.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Fetches the live list of public repos from GET /orgs/canada-ca/repos?type=public&per_page=100 (paginated). Selects 15 repos at random. For each, asserts that the CSV contains a row with the exact repo_name and the correct repo_url (https://github.com/canada-ca/<name>).
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Catches agents that fabricate repository names or URLs instead of fetching them from GitHub.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the same 15 spot-check repos, calls GET /repos/canada-ca/<name> and reads the 'language' field. Asserts the CSV primary_language matches (case-insensitive), or both are null/Unknown.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabrication of programming language values.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, fetches the raw content of LICENSE / LICENSE.md / LICENCE from the GitHub Contents API. Extracts the SPDX identifier using keyword matching (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, OGL-Canada-2.0, etc.). Asserts the CSV licence field matches the extracted identifier, or both are Unknown.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from guessing or fabricating licence identifiers without reading the actual file.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, checks for SECURITY.md in root, .github/, and docs/ via the Contents API. If found, reads the file and applies the same substantive-content heuristic (length > 200 chars and contains at least one of: 'report', 'vulnerability', 'disclose', 'contact', 'email'). Asserts the CSV security_policy value (Present/Incomplete/Missing) matches the verifier's independent judgment.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from marking all repos as Present or Missing without reading the actual file content.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, checks for CONTRIBUTING.md or CONTRIBUTING in root and .github/ via the Contents API. Asserts the CSV contributing_guide value (Yes/No) matches the verifier's finding.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabrication of contributing guide presence.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, calls GET /repos/canada-ca/<name>/commits?per_page=1 and reads the committer date. Asserts the CSV last_commit_date matches within ±1 day (to allow for timezone differences).
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabrication of commit dates, which directly affects the maintained standard.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, recomputes maintained from the verified last_commit_date (Yes if days_since_last_commit <= 365, No otherwise). Asserts the CSV maintained value matches.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the derived maintained field is correctly computed from the raw date, not independently fabricated.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, calls GET /repos/canada-ca/<name> and reads open_issues_count, then calls GET /repos/canada-ca/<name>/pulls?state=open&per_page=1 with Link header parsing to get PR count. Asserts CSV open_issues_count equals (API open_issues_count - PR count), within ±3 to allow for race conditions.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures issue counts exclude pull requests as required by the task contract.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, checks for SBOM files (bom.json, bom.xml, sbom.spdx.json, cyclonedx.json, sbom.json, sbom.xml) in root, .github/, and docs/ via the Contents API. Also checks for dependency manifests (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, Cargo.lock, requirements.txt, pom.xml) in root. Asserts CSV sbom_exists and dependency_manifest_exists match.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabrication of SBOM presence, which is the primary standard being audited.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, fetches the .github/workflows/ directory listing and reads each workflow YAML file. Searches for dependency-scanning keywords: npm audit, pip-audit, safety, snyk, trivy, grype, owasp-dependency-check, dependency-review. Asserts CSV has_dependency_scanning_in_ci matches (Yes if any keyword found, No CI if no workflows directory, No otherwise).
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from marking repos as having CI dependency scanning without reading the actual workflow files.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, calls GET /repos/canada-ca/<name>/pulls?state=open&per_page=100 and counts PRs where the user login is 'dependabot[bot]' or the head ref starts with 'dependabot/'. Asserts CSV open_dependabot_prs matches within ±2.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabrication of Dependabot PR counts.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, independently recomputes standards_met from the CSV field values using the formula in instruction.md: S1=(sbom_exists==Yes OR dependency_manifest_exists==Yes), S2=(licence!=Unknown), S3=(security_policy==Present), S4=(contributing_guide==Yes), S5=(maintained==Yes), S6=(has_dependency_scanning_in_ci==Yes). Asserts CSV standards_met equals the recomputed value.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures standards_met is derived from the actual field values, not independently fabricated.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For all rows, recomputes compliance_status from standards_met: Full if ==6, Partial if 2-5, Non-compliant if 0-1. Asserts CSV compliance_status matches for every row.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the compliance tier is correctly derived from standards_met.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For the 15 spot-check repos, recomputes the gaps list from the field values and asserts it matches the CSV gaps column (order-insensitive, semicolon-separated). A repo with standards_met==6 must have gaps=='None'.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the gaps column accurately reflects which standards are failing.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Reads the CSV and counts Full, Partial, Non-compliant rows. Asserts output.json fully_compliant, partially_compliant, non_compliant, and total_repos_audited match the CSV counts exactly.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Ensures the briefing note statistics are derived from the actual CSV data.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that no two rows in the CSV have the same repo_name. Duplicate rows would inflate the row count without doing additional work.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents padding the CSV with duplicate entries to satisfy the row-count check.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For each row, counts the number of fields containing 'Unknown'. Asserts that no more than 30% of rows have more than 8 Unknown values out of 22 columns (>36%). A high Unknown rate across many rows indicates the agent gave up on data collection rather than fetching real values.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from filling the CSV with Unknown values to avoid making API calls.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that not more than 90% of rows share the same compliance_status value. A real audit of 74 diverse repos will produce a distribution across Full, Partial, and Non-compliant.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from marking all repos as Full or all as Non-compliant without doing real checks.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For any row where compliance_status=='Full', asserts that sbom_exists=='Yes' OR dependency_manifest_exists=='Yes', licence!='Unknown', security_policy=='Present', contributing_guide=='Yes', maintained=='Yes', and has_dependency_scanning_in_ci=='Yes'. A Full row with contradictory field values indicates fabrication.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents agents from marking repos as fully compliant while leaving evidence fields as Unknown or No.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Computes the gaps string for every row. Asserts that fewer than 70% of rows with standards_met < 6 share the exact same gaps string. Identical gaps across all non-compliant repos would indicate the agent applied a single template rather than evaluating each repo individually.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents boilerplate gap lists that don't reflect per-repo reality.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Reads the briefing_note string from output.json. Asserts that at least 3 distinct repository names (from the CSV repo_name column) appear verbatim in the briefing note text.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents generic boilerplate briefing notes that don't reference the actual audit findings.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Asserts that the briefing_note string is at least 300 words and no more than 800 words, consistent with 2–3 substantive paragraphs.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents one-sentence placeholder briefing notes.

checks.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Reads highest_risk_repos from output.json. Asserts that every repo name listed exists in the CSV repo_name column and that each entry has a non-empty reason string of at least 20 characters.
checks.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Prevents fabricated or generic risk repo lists.
